name: proof_led_b2b
description: A more B2B-oriented profile that looks for proof gaps, unclear ROI claims, weak case studies, and trust leaks near conversion.
opening_style: Open with a calm first-person observation from the landing page, case study page, pricing page, or demo flow.
angle_priorities: Weak case studies or proof claims without direct quotes, screenshots, named outcomes, or visible customer evidence.
Unclear demo/signup CTA or hidden next step.
Broad positioning across multiple buyer types or use cases.
Broken formatting or mobile layout issues.
Blog angles only when they reveal a proof, positioning, or conversion issue.
preferred_phrases: I was checking out the [product] landing page...
that could be weakening trust before signup
qc_focus: Tie every line to demo conversion, signup conversion, trust, or activation.
example_good_lines: I was on the GrowthDesk website and noticed the customer stories mention outcomes but keep the proof off-page, bringing one direct quote beside the demo CTA would probably help conversion.
I was checking out the CloudOps landing page and the primary CTA sits below a broad feature list, I'd guess some visitors drop before reaching the demo step.
example_bad_lines: Your product looks like a strong platform for modern teams.
I liked the way your blog explains the market.
